description: Institutions adopt long-term budgeting climate accountability future-generation review and public investment rules.
Present actors maximize growth profit political wins and resource use while deferring long-term costs.
Mitigation adaptation loss-and-damage finance just transition and restoration are treated as duties across generations.
AI surveillance digital identity and platform infrastructure become embedded without sufficient accountability.
Infrastructure public health education and ecological systems are neglected until failure becomes visible.
Long-term responsibility includes land climate racial ecological and fiscal repair.
Youth movements assemblies litigation and civic institutions reshape long-term policy.
Crises overwhelm planning capacity and short-term emergency governance becomes permanent.
